content.title: Where is TPC San Antonio and the 2026 Valero Texas Open located?
content.text: TPC San Antonio is home to the 2026 Valero Texas Open, home to an event on the PGA Tour in 2026 and one of the tournaments on the PGA Tour schedule. The San Antonio, Texas, area course has a great look and lots of demands for ballstrikers as a Greg Norman design. Not only is TPC San Antonio a great golf course, but it is also home to the PGA Tour and its 2026 Valero Texas Open, which features some of the best in the world playing in the Lone Star state. Naturally, a club hosting a big golf tournament on the PGA Tour leads fans to wonder where TPC San Antonio is located. TPC San Antonio is a private facility, with play reserved for TPC members and guests of the on-site JW Marriott resort. Neighboring towns to San Antonio, Texas, include Timberwood Park and Selma. Which airports are near TPC San Antonio? The biggest airport in close proximity to TPC San Antonio is San Antonio Intercontinental Airport, where golfers who are playing at the course will fly into before making the trek. It's an approximately 30-minute drive from the airport to TPC San Antonio. What other famous golf courses are near TPC San Antonio? TPC San Antonio is a great golf course in San Antonio, but it has some incredible neighbors in the golf world. Clubs nearby include La Cantera Golf Course, Canyon Springs Golf Club and Dominion Country Club. I was also curious, so I asked Emma Seymour, the associate director of the Textiles, Paper & Apparel Lab, what the real reason for those bath towel lines is. She told me that it's called a "dobby border" and explained why most (though not all) bath towels have them. If you've got towels on the brain, you can also check out our collection of clever uses for old towels and find out why textiles pros say you should never use a bath towel at the beach. Of course, we also have plenty of recommendations for the best bath towels, the best quick-dry towels, and the best Turkish towels. Below, Seymour explains exactly why your bath towels have those lines. What's the purpose of a towel line? "It's the dobby border, common on many bath towels," says Seymour. "It helps the towel keep its shape because it offers more structure than if it was entirely terrycloth. It also helps prevent fraying."What is a dobby border?A dobby border is a woven strip near a towel's ends. It can appear as a single strip or multiple, but it is always located near a towel's edges.According to Seymour, "Testers tend to like the look of the border, but most don't comment on it if a towel lacks a dobby border," meaning it's not a make-or-break feature for most customers.Do towels need a dobby border?Not necessarily. A towel without a dobby border will still absorb, as is its primary function. However, it may not have the same durability and longevity as one with a dobby border. It's about weighing out what's most important to you when shopping. If the price is right, and you like the look of a towel without a dobby border, buy it. There are other factors that contribute to a towel's durability and performance, such as fiber content, fabric weight, construction and more, not just the dobby border. So the towel you select may still go the distance. Our textiles pro filled us in on the real reason bath towels have those lines. Fowler, who is outside the top 50 in the Official World Golf Rankings, needs to win this weekend to secure at spot at the Masters, an event he’s only qualified for once in the past five years, finishing a tie for 30th back in 2024. The beloved golfer got off to an inauspicious start in his first round at the Valero Texas Open, bogeying three of his first six holes to sit at two-over and well off the lead. More Golf: Tiger Woods Makes Troubling Decision After Car Accident: Report More Golf: PGA Tour Makes Final Decision on Tiger Woods After Announcement As he attempts to win his way to Augusta National Golf Club, news of Fowler’s future schedule dropped. Fowler will head to Quail Hollow Club for the Truist Championship in early May, the club announced on social media. “Back where it all began. @RickieFowler returns to Quail Hollow Club, the site of his first @PGATOUR victory in 2012,” Truist announced on social media. Fowler got off to a hot start in the 2025 rendition of the tournament and sat tied for the lead after the first round when he fired a seven-under, 63. He struggled to capitalize on his early success and finished in a tie for 15th place. In 13 appearances at the event he’s only missed the cut one time and has finished in the top 20 in nearly half of his appearances (six).
